cases.comparison: Guest setup verifies a real failed write; retain each candidate status and each available raw diagnostic; later failures do not erase reached outcomes.
cases.oracle: Independent /dev/full rejection control; exact netstat call statuses, captured output and same-shell recovery.
cases.purpose: Observe failure and same-shell recovery after an actual netstat table write to /dev/full.
cases.script:
[[ $UID == 2000 && $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
[[ -c /dev/full ]] || exit 125
[[ $(type -t netstat) == builtin ]] || exit 125
# Capture each actual call separately; the third must run in the same shell.
netstat -t >"$HOME/before.out" 2>"$HOME/before.err"; before=$?
netstat -t >/dev/full 2>"$HOME/full.err"; full=$?
netstat -t >"$HOME/after.out" 2>"$HOME/after.err"; after=$?
printf 'before=%s full=%s after=%s\n' "$before" "$full" "$after" >"$HOME/netstat.status" || exit 125
[[ $before == 0 && $full == 1 && $after == 0 && -s $HOME/before.out && -s $HOME/after.out ]] || exit 1
printf 'netstat-full-recovery=verified\n'
cases.setup_script:
[[ $UID == 2000 && $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
[[ -c /dev/full ]] || exit 125
# Positive control: the actual guest /dev/full rejects writes; verify this
# independently, before candidate execution, using the same unprivileged shell.
: >"$HOME/full-control.err" || exit 125
if printf 'control\n' >/dev/full 2>"$HOME/full-control.err"; then full=0; else full=$?; fi
printf 'control-ok\n' >"$HOME/full-control.out"; next=$?
printf 'full=%s next=%s\n' "$full" "$next" >"$HOME/full-control.status" || exit 125
(( full != 0 && next == 0 )) && [[ -s $HOME/full-control.err ]] || exit 125
